description:
Update a FreeAgent bill — correct the reference, dates or VAT status, allocate it to a project, set the rebill treatment, attach or replace the supplier invoice, or edit its line items.

Only the fields you pass are changed. Line items are addressed by their own URL: a line with no itemUrl is ADDED, a line with itemUrl is edited, and destroy=true removes it. Omit items entirely to leave the existing lines alone — read them from freeagent_get_bill first, which returns each line's itemUrl.

contact.description: Move the bill to a different supplier

contentType.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file name if omitted.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded supplier invoice. LAST RESORT — prefer filePath or fileUrl.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local invoice file. The SERVER reads and encodes it.

fileUrl.description: URL of a supplier invoice to download and attach.

items.description: Line items to add, edit or remove — see the description for the rules

categoryUrl.description: Category for the line (required on a new line)

destroy.description: Set true with itemUrl to delete that line

itemUrl.description: URL of an existing line to edit or remove. Omit to add a new line.

totalValue.description: Line total including tax (required on a new line)

project.description: Project to allocate this bill to

rebillFactor.description: Markup percentage or fixed price — required for markup/price

rebillType.description: How to rebill this to the client — needs the bill to be on a project

name: freeagent_update_bill
